title: Editor: upload (logical shape)
description: POST /_portal/editor/uploads is multipart/form-data with one part named `file`. This schema is that part's logical shape. The server verifies the type by decoding with Pillow; at most 5 MB. 201 editor-upload-response (200 when the same bytes were uploaded before); 413 file_too_large, 415 unsupported_media_type. Staff only (401 not_authenticated, 403 forbidden), CSRF required (PLAN §2.3.5, §2.11).
